Claude in practice

A real integration. Open to inspection.

Claude is central to Yankı: it reads the user's passage and produces the reflection. The live experience and public source show how we put the model to work.

01

Try the live product

Write your own text in Yankı and receive a new response. The beta calls the live service and shows an error when a reflection is unavailable.

02

See how Claude is used

Yankı calls Anthropic's API directly. The application checks response structure and quoted text, with a separate rule check for crisis wording. These checks reduce risk; they do not make every response correct.

03

Inspect the source

The public repository contains the prompt, API integration and response checks. You can see what the application asks of Claude and how it handles the result.
